vars.goal: a title menu as the main scene res://main.tscn (root Main, a Control) with Menu/StartButton, Menu/SettingsButton and Menu/QuitButton, where Start adds a track select (a child of Main named TrackSelect, with a button Box/Grid/Track<N>Button per track, open once the track before was finished in the top two, and Box/BackButton back to the menu) and choosing a track adds the race scene res://game/game.tscn as a child of Main named Game, with the track's id in its property track, its state property "countdown" until the start (then "racing") and the track's name in HUD/TrackLabel (track 1 is Ashfall Oval); pause: Escape or the button HUD/PauseButton shows the race's PauseMenu node (a CanvasLayer with ResumeButton, RestartButton and QuitButton) and pauses the tree, ResumeButton hides it and resumes, RestartButton starts the race again from the countdown; track 2, Ember Esses, in data/tracks.json under the key TRACK_2 of a translation table i18n/strings.csv; a data.json for the kit's data runner; and a save by a SaveStore class (scripts/SaveStore.cs: new SaveStore(path) with Read() and Write(SaveData data), which returns whether it wrote, where SaveData has Unlocked, the furthest track open, and Best, each track's best lap in milliseconds in a dictionary by track id as text) in user://save.json
